cryptoTrack.wipe.backupTitle: Step 1 · a backup of the vault
cryptoTrack.wipe.backupHint: Without a fresh copy the wipe does not start: the confirmation will say a copy is needed first.
cryptoTrack.wipe.backupFailed: The vault could not be copied
cryptoTrack.wipe.title: Step 2 · wipe the crypto module
cryptoTrack.wipe.empty: There is nothing to wipe: the crypto module is empty.
cryptoTrack.wipe.askLead: The vault copies itself and checks the copy opens. Only then is anything removed.
cryptoTrack.wipe.walletsStay: No wallet is deleted: each loses its link to the module and goes to the archive with its history.
cryptoTrack.wipe.backupFirst: A copy of the vault is made first, and checked that it opens.
cryptoTrack.wipe.secretsGo: The exchange keys, the network addresses and the Blockscout key of this device are removed.
cryptoTrack.wipe.biometricGoes: Quick unlock by biometrics on this device is switched off.
cryptoTrack.wipe.noUndoBody: The data can only come back from a copy of the vault.
cryptoTrack.wipe.failed: The crypto module could not be wiped
